name: Brisk Loop
description: Turn the circuit through the legs at speed so one step becomes two quick strides.

name: Loop Blow
description: Close the loop at the instant of impact so the blow lands with the full turn of qi.

name: Loop Guard
description: Keep the loop turning round the forearms so a blow meets a hard spinning guard.

name: Loop Feel
description: Feel the turn of your own circuit and any foe's through the point of contact.

name: Wheel Outburst
description: Let the whole wheel fly outward from the chest in a ring that shoves back all within reach.

name: Spinning Ward
description: Spin the guard arm on the wheel so a blow is thrown off line and the attacker's balance with it.

name: Wheel Salving
description: Turn the wheel slowly over a wounded ally or yourself until torn flesh knits and pain recedes.

name: Crushing Wheel
description: Press the spinning wheel of qi into a foe and keep grinding until their stance gives and their guard wears through.

name: Unbroken Wheel
description: Spin the great wheel round the body so blows glance away and the user's own strength builds with each turn.

name: Qi Brush
description: Let the skin of qi extend an arm's length and feel what moves within it.

name: Qi Push
description: Shove a lump of outer qi from the palm and send it a few paces into the target.

name: Qi Cover
description: Hold the outer field close as a loose cover so strikes lose force before they reach the skin.

name: Qi Glide
description: Slide across the ground on the field so each step covers more than the legs alone could.

name: Qi Lash
description: Whip a rope of outer qi at a foe's guard arm or weapon hand to spoil the stroke.

name: Qi Mooring
description: Sink a thick root of outer qi into the ground at a foe's feet and hold them where they stand.

name: Unfurled Wave
description: Gather the outer field for a long breath then loose it all at once as a vast pressing wave around the user.

name: Living Veil
description: Draw the field down into a close sheath that shields the user and feeds each limb with calm strength.

name: Lead Palm
description: Let the arm hang heavy with qi and swing it up so the palm lands with a slow dull weight.

name: Weighted Beat
description: Drop the weight of the body into one beat of qi and strike on the downward fall.

name: Beat Brace
description: Set the stance on a held beat and let qi in the legs soak the force of a heavy blow.

name: Beat Shift
description: Move off the line of a blow in the pause after one beat and before the next.

name: Beat Listen
description: Rest a hand on a surface and listen through it to the footfalls and heartbeats nearby.

name: Hammer Pulse
description: Drive a blunt pulse of qi into a guard so the blocking arm numbs and the guard drops.

name: Deep Knock
description: Knock once with a stiff finger so the pulse passes the surface and shakes the organs beneath.

name: Pulse Screen
description: Beat a slow pulse of qi in front of the body that scatters missiles and weakens close blows.

name: Drumfall
description: Stamp and let the stored beat roll outward as a thudding wave that bowls over everyone close.

name: Breaking Beat
description: Land one huge beat of qi through the guard with the whole body behind it to split the defense open.

name: Living Skin
description: Let the field cling to the skin like a second hide that softens blows.

name: Living Palm
description: Strike with a palm wrapped in a thick bloom of the field so it lands as a wide push.

name: Living Tread
description: Take a long even stride that the field lifts and carries a little further than the legs.

name: Living Gauge
description: Read the health and reserve of every ally standing inside the field as warm glows.

name: Living Weave
description: Weave the field into a cloth over a wounded ally or yourself that blocks blows and slowly closes hurts.

name: Living Lash
description: Flick a tongue of the field out from the hand and strike a target at medium reach.

name: Living Snare
description: Spread the field thin across the ground and close it round the legs of those who step in.

name: Qi Renewal
description: Fill the field with soft warm qi until every ally within it heals wounds at a steady pace.

name: Qi Wash
description: Sweep the field through the channels of allies within it and push out poison taint and sour deviation backlash.

name: Pair Throb
description: Strike with both palms one after the other so the second blow follows the first in step.

name: Pair Loop
description: Cross both forearms with matched circuits so the guard is one piece and takes a blow evenly.

name: Pair Cadence
description: Move both feet on matched circuits so the step lands even and the guard stays closed.

name: Pair Feeling
description: Read a foe through both hands at once and compare the two readings for the lie between them.

name: Twin Wheel
description: Run two wheels on two arms so one arm strikes and the other turns the answer aside.

name: Twin Thread
description: Cast one thread from each hand and draw them together around a foe's torso to pin the arms.

name: Mirror Pulse
description: Take a blow on one palm and send the pulse across the body and out of the other.

name: Twin Upwelling
description: Throw two great surges from two hands that cross in front and burst across a wide arc.

name: Yoked Circuit
description: Yoke the user's circuit to an ally's so both share one guard and one rising strength.

name: Hawk Vision
description: Sharpen the sense of qi to see the faint glow of living bodies across a wide space.

name: Hawk Dart
description: Fire a small hard dart of qi from two fingers at a target in clear view.

name: Dropping Stride
description: Drop from a height or a ledge on a cushion of qi and land poised to strike.

name: Wingspread Guard
description: Spread both arms like wings with qi along the edges and sweep strikes aside to either flank.

name: Talon Palm
description: Hook the fingers on a palm strike so the qi tears at the surface as the hand drags down.

name: Talon Thread
description: Stab a hooked thread of qi through a narrow gap and pull it back to open the wound.

name: Wing Shift
description: Beat the arms once to throw qi out and vault to either side of an attacker.

name: Marking Gaze
description: Fix the sense of qi on one foe and follow every motion so their feints no longer fool you.

name: Hawk Plummet
description: Leap high on a gathered burst of qi and come down on the target with the weight of the fall.

name: Recalled Heartbeat
description: Pour a held breath of qi into the chest of an ally whose breath has just stopped and call it back within moments.

name: Inner Drive
description: Fold the field in against the body so qi crowds the limbs and adds drive to every motion.

name: Outer Shell
description: Push the field out as a loose bubble that slows and weakens blows on their way in.

name: Inner Palm
description: Strike with the inner field packed tight in the arm so the palm hits with held strength.

name: Outer Step
description: Let the outer field push against the ground and stretch the stride beyond the legs.

name: Meeting Strike
description: Meet the foe where inner and outer field touch and strike while the shell holds firm.

name: Dual Veil
description: Hold both fields as one thick veil that stops heavy blows and sheds the leftover force.

name: Paired Swell
description: Swell both fields at once so a shell guards the user while a ring of force rolls out.

name: Qi Exchange
description: Trade the user's inner field into an ally to ease their wounds and refill their qi.

name: Oath Inhale
description: Swear one slow breath before an action so the qi stays steady until the breath is spent.

name: Sworn Pulse
description: Strike on the sworn breath so the full held qi arrives in the palm.

name: Held Step
description: Step on the held breath so the foot lands without a wobble or a sound.

name: Bearing Thread
description: Read the line from the user to a foe through qi and note which way they lean.

name: Held Veil
description: Hold the sworn breath and a close guard together so blows meet a body that does not move.

name: Bearing Blow
description: Strike along the held line to throw the foe's balance off the bearing they were keeping.

name: Oath Flow
description: Give the sworn breath to a hurt ally so it knits wounds at a steady held pace.

name: Sworn Upsurge
description: Let the whole sworn breath go in one outward surge that bears down on all near.

name: Pledge Held Entire
description: Hold the oath through every blow so the guard grows firmer and the user's strength more constant.

name: Bearing Pulse
description: Strike along a chosen line with the stance fixed on it so the palm cannot be turned off.

name: Bearing Cloak
description: Fix the guard on the line of the attack and let qi hold it there against the blow.

name: Bearing Slide
description: Slide along a chosen line with steady qi in the soles and arrive without any sway.

name: Held Inhale
description: Hold a full breath after the draw so qi stays packed in the chest for the next strike.

name: Square Bearing
description: Check by feel that the user's own stance and flow are true and level.

name: Level Lance
description: Drive qi straight along the line through a narrow gap in a foe's guard to the body beyond.

name: Steady Hold
description: Hold a steady push of qi against a foe's chest until their advance stops.

name: Purging Current
description: Breathe out slowly while drawing stale qi and taint from an ally or yourself with the breath.

name: Pinned Bearing
description: Strike along the fixed line with all held qi and pin the foe against any move off it.

name: Oath Renewed
description: Renew the sworn breath over an ally so wounds close and spent qi returns to the channels.

name: Oath Pulse
description: Strike from the edge of the field with the whole oath behind the palm.

name: Oath Cover
description: Spread the oath-field over nearby allies as a light cover that blunts the first blow.

name: Oath Stride
description: Stride to the edge of the oath-field in one beat and plant the stance there.

name: Oath Measure
description: Feel who stands inside the oath-field and how steady the qi in each of them runs.

name: Oath Crackle
description: Whip the edge of the oath-field out at a foe beyond its border.

name: Oath Bind
description: Close the oath-field's edge round a foe who crosses it and hold them in place.

name: Wide Oath
description: Swell the oath-field to its widest and push its whole edge outward as a crushing ring.

name: Sworn Healing
description: Fill the oath-field with steady healing qi that mends every ally standing within it.
